method: sequential requests on one warm tb1 session; client and server on the same host; server SQL cache disabled; provider prompt caching uncontrolled

records.question: average speed per vessel
records.deltaText:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, avg(speed) as avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
records.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, avg(speed) as avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

records.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
records.deltaText:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= '2026-09-12 23:59:54' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
records.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= '2026-09-12 23:59:54' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

records.question: max wave height per vessel per day
records.deltaText:
-- view: bar
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, vessel, max(wave_height) AS max_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY day, vessel ORDER BY day, vessel
records.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, vessel, max(wave_height) AS max_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY day, vessel ORDER BY day, vessel

records.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week

records.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, avg(water_temp) AS temp FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= '2026-09-07 23:59:54' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

records.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
